_reason: db_conn is an opaque sqlite3.Connection handle to the per-workspace pa.db — a live runtime object, not a serializable value. This descriptor documents the SEEDED DB STATE the review-scopes tests build via pa_server.init_db + direct INSERTs (the shape pa_review reads through the shared routine-engine ranker + the pa_core_task_window_read read), not a literal connection.

blockers.description: legal sign-off pending (undated — excluded from a windowed review)

note: VALID M0a enums only — status in the legacy CHECK set ('new'/'executing' etc), priority 'high'/'low' (NOT 'in_progress' / numerics). due_at tokens (TODAY/+Nd) are resolved by the test body relative to a fixed NOW (2026-06-15, a Monday). Built to exercise: per-scope time windows (today/tomorrow/week/month), out-of-window exclusion, workstream grouping (week, from tags[0]), milestone grouping (month, from planning_period), the 'unassigned' bucket for untagged/no-period tasks, undated-item exclusion (the blocker), shared-ranker order preservation within groups, and remote-field wrap preservation (the ingested nudge).
